test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following, under the Weaker Sections category, are eligible to avail loans under priority sector loans?

options.text: Artisans, village and cottage industries where individual credit limits exceed ₹1 lakh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Self Help Group**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Self-help groups are **informal groups of people who come together to address their common problems**. 
 
• Some Villages face multiple problems related to poverty, illiteracy, lack of formal credit etc. These types of problems cannot go out at a particular level and require collective efforts
 
• It provides guarantee-free loans with terms finalized by the group at market-driven rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The persons with disabilities are used to apply to all persons with disabilities including those who have long-period physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairments which, in interaction with various Posture and environmental fencing obstruct their full and effective participation in society on an equal.
 
• Farmer who has more than 10 hectares of land are big farmers, the farmers who have 2 or less than 2 hectares of land are mentioned to as small farmers and those who range between 2 to 10 hectares are known as middle farmers.
